```yaml
name: Regenerate Sonar API spec

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 6 * * *'  # 06:00 UTC daily
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  regenerate-sonar-api-spec:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 22

      - name: Install pnpm
        run: npm install -g pnpm@9.4.0

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Get Octavia Bot token
        id: octavia
        uses: DataDog/dd-octo-sts-action@acaa02eee7e3bb0839e4272dacb37b8f3b58ba80
        with:
          domain: airbytehq
          audience: https://github.com/airbytehq/airbyte
          scope: repo
          policy: .github/policies/octavia-bot-policy.json

      - name: Set GITHUB_TOKEN for subsequent steps
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ steps.octavia.outputs.token }}
        run: echo "GITHUB_TOKEN=${{ steps.octavia.outputs.token }}" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Generate Sonar API spec
        run: node prepare-embedded-api-spec.js

      - name: Format with Prettier
        run: npx prettier --write .

      - name: Check for changes
        id: check_diff
        run: |
          if git diff --quiet; then
            echo "changed=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          else
            echo "changed=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi

      - name: Set remote URL with Octavia Bot token
        if: steps.check_diff.outputs.changed == 'true'
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ steps.octavia.outputs.token }}
        run: |
          git remote set-url origin https://x-access-token:${{ steps.octavia.outputs.token }}@github.com/${{ github.repository }}

      - name: Commit and push changes
        if: steps.check_diff.outputs.changed == 'true'
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ steps.octavia.outputs.token }}
        run: |
          SONAR_BRANCH=sonar-api-spec-update-$(date -u +%Y%m%d)
          echo "SONAR_BRANCH=${SONAR_BRANCH}" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          git config user.name "octavia-bot"
          git config user.email "octavia-bot@users.noreply.github.com"
          git checkout -b $SONAR_BRANCH
          git add .
          git commit -m "docs: regenerate Sonar API spec"
          git push origin $SONAR_BRANCH

      - name: Create Pull Request
        if: steps.check_diff.outputs.changed == 'true'
        uses: actions/github-script@v6
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ steps.octavia.outputs.token }}
          SONAR_BRANCH: ${{ env.SONAR_BRANCH }}
        with:
          script: |
            const { owner, repo } = context.repo;
            const branch = process.env.SONAR_BRANCH;
            const title = "docs: regenerate Sonar API spec";
            const body = "Automated regeneration of Sonar API spec.";
            const labels = ["auto-merge", "autogenerated", "documentation"];
            const { data: pr } = await github.rest.pulls.create({
              owner,
              repo,
              title,
              head: branch,
              base: "main",
              body,
              draft: false,
            });
            await github.rest.issues.addLabels({
              owner,
              repo,
              issue_number: pr.number,
              labels,
            });
```
